about: Menuless questing v1.0 coverage fixture for tools/test_questline.php (research/pt19-menuless-v1-spec.md section 3, Lane E). LAYERS come from the index only: closed = the layer line of parent_info (or the parent row's links when layer lines were de-duplicated) - and every line the layer line carries must be on the built list or be the other prompt of a linked topic; single = the parent row's links resolved to one visible line ("-" = a prompt-less parent: then no layer line may carry the line); root = named top-level topics ({topic, info_key, live_text} allowed). A linked topic whose INFOs carry DIFFERENT prompts shows one of them by its conditions: layer.variants {topic_key: info_key | "-" (hidden at this beat)} names it, with the evidence in variants_note - left unnamed, the builder refuses. BEAT keys: id, quest, npc, origin (engine|glue), scene (the owning quest of her scene; sj is DERIVED from its journal rows, sc_expected must agree), amb (an ambient scene), facts (clicks_ok pg sp bamt fac q qst sq sqj guard bounty cf mq101c), clicks ([0, 1]: run every line at each), live_text / live (what the menu prints for a token), expect (the class of the first line: pick explicit park single auto check pay slot words scene none open entry faction-words faction-open chain) and stageB (a scene beat's class at clicks_ok 1), spec_class (the spec table's class when the index proves another one - a layer's shape, never a grading), ruling_note (the spec's row contradicts the index and no re-class is allowed: the spec's path is asserted and each line is a known @spec_row entry for the spec owner), warm_root (her root was cached by an E-press: 5.3 step 2), rail (at clicks_ok 0 the one rail sentence is asserted - the harness computes model R8 and U7 itself), rail0 (a clicks_ok 1 beat is also said at clicks_ok 0: nothing clicked, the true rail sentence), rail_names (texts the rail sentence must name as pickable), chain + purses (one sentence, several clicks - step layers and targets; per purse what the LAST click does: pick or ask), assents (the owner's assents for a park, rotated per line; default yes / okay / yes, I'm sure / uh yeah sure, I swear on the oaths; odd lines are released by a words-only reply, F27), fe (section 3.7 only), reward (--stage=B). SAY: t (the player's words; "" = no new words), via (the path that must be measured), adv (the grace an auto line must carry), note, spec_via (the specialist's / the spec's path when the measured one differs - only for a real floor miss (spec 3.4 step 5: park / words) or a class the index proves, never to absorb another lane's defect). NEVER: lines that must click nothing (model 2.4: a refusal also stops the breath). KNOWN: "<beat>|<t>" ("@0"/"@1" appended on a clicks beat; "<beat>|never|<t>", "<beat>|rail|<t>", "<beat>|rail0|<t>", "<beat>|<t>|<purse>" on a chain) -> {why: "@<code>"} (a known_reasons entry: owner + why) or {owner, why}: a defect the owning lane fixes - it FAILS the default run (the release gate) with its owner named; --allow-known reports it without failing. CROSS: lethal, price_list, park_tail (a printed probe, S4.4 by design), leave, sweep, hub (read by test_prompt_index 5d too). Paraphrases: research/pt19c-language-paraphrases.json (the spec's own rows, every natural and STT line). Re-measure after a tree change with --remeasure=<out> (park / words only; the merge's targets and known lines are never moved) and --scoped-merge (what the build does once the merge is scoped). BUILD FIX (pt19c build fixer, 2026-09-25): lrgPromptEscalate is scoped to the line's own topic (+ every lethal row) whenever her quest or the layer's parent INFO says which topic the line is, and a line whose candidates disagree on top-level no longer votes on root / closed - every @merge entry passed on the plain, --words and --first-evening runs and was removed with its merge notes; only the @spec_row entries (the spec owner's rulings) remain. RULINGS (pt19c final fixer, 2026-09-25 - the spec owner's, on the completeness critic's recommendations): MQ102.balgruuf.intro and MQ105.arngeir.summons are re-classed explicit / park (the target's own topic carries goodbye / scripted INFOs, so the fail-safe commit grade is right and the right line is clicked in every case), and FE.riverwood.plain's "sing me something about dragons" moves from never to say via pick (it clicks Sven's own ballads line); each beat's `ruling` gives the evidence, each line's `spec_via` the spec's old path, and every @spec_row entry is gone with its reason.
